name: Fieldy
description: Connect your Fieldy account to Claude to retrieve and review conversations captured with Fieldy. Browse recent conversations or a specific date range, open a conversation with its available summary and transcript, and retrieve exact timestamped transcript lines with speaker labels.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fieldy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fieldy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.fieldy.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fieldy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fieldy provides these MCP tools: fieldy_get_conversation, fieldy_list_conversations_in_time_range, fieldy_list_recent_conversations, fieldy_list_transcripts, and fieldy_share_conversation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fieldy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fieldy in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Fieldy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fieldy is developed by Adomas Valiukevicius. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
